content: Letter 37, to Sayyid Qāsim-i Anvār: a brief letter of eulogy and friendship, closing with an inquiry after the shaykh's health; the postscript greets his disciples and singles out the jurist ʿAzīz Jalāl Yūsuf, most probably Jalāl al-Dīn Yūsuf Awbahī, student of Saʿd al-Dīn Taftāzānī and prominent among Herat's ulama. MK infers from one descriptor that Qāsim-i Anvār held the position of naqīb in Herat (TMN/MS pp. 29-30, TMN/D pp. 207-9; edition in P.2.1).
